'''Dagger Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The first unit to be equipped with the then-experimental [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]], they were activated and sent into [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] in a last-ditch effort to save a unit of Rebels that had become trapped behind [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] lines.

==Pilots==
*[[K7 "Black Dagger" Security Droid|Black Dagger]] - [[Netrem Pollard/Legends|Netrem Pollard]], [[Human/Legends|Human]] {{C|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]]}}
*[[Blue Dagger]] - [[Nera Dantels]], [[Human/Legends|Human]]
*[[Gold Dagger]] - [[Callen Troyt]], [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]]
*[[Scarlet Dagger]] - [[Vin Nothos]], [[Human/Legends|Human]]
*[[Suskafoo]], [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]

==Behind the scenes==
Hasbro released a Dagger Squadron B-wing toy, with a figure of Pollard as a Toys 'R Us exclusive, in the summer of 2008.
